s: Din hammitpallel shette tepillot ubo seip echad: hammitpallel b' tepillot zo achar zo, kegon shacharit umusap, o sheshshakach velo hitpallel, vetzarik lehashlimah bizman tepilla shelleachareha umitpallel shettayim zo achar zo — tzarik lehamtin ben zo lazo, kede shettehe dato meyushshebet laarok debarayv bilshon techinna, dehaynu kede hilluk d' ammot, apillu eno rotzeh lachazor limqomo ella mitpallel shenit bemaqom sheomed sham kesheppasa achar tepilla harishona, abal lachazor limqomo apillu eno rotzeh lehitpallel shenit — tzarik lehamtin kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qk"g:
